<p class="eyebrow hero-enter delay1">Oracle ACE Pro <i class="dot"></i> AI Consultant <i class="dot"></i> Application Architect <i class="dot"></i> Houston, TX</p>
<h1 class="hero-enter delay2">I implement<br>Oracle Fusion ERP.<br>I engineer the <em>AI</em> on top.</h1>
<div class="signal-line hero-enter delay3"><span></span></div>
<p class="hero-lede hero-enter delay3">Twenty-four years of end-to-end ERP delivery. Hands-on AI engineering with agents, retrieval systems and forecasting, shipped to production.</p>
<div class="hero-actions hero-enter delay4"><a class="button button-primary" href="mailto:shiv.arun.iyer@gmail.com?subject=Discovery%20call">Book a discovery call <b>→</b></a><a class="button button-secondary" href="#work">Explore the work <b>→</b></a></div>

<main>
<section class="section intro" id="expertise">
<div class="section-kicker" data-reveal><span>01</span> The intersection</div>
<div class="intro-grid"><div data-reveal><p class="eyebrow">Two practices. One delivery mindset.</p><h2>Enterprise depth.<br><em>Builder's instinct.</em></h2></div><div class="intro-copy" data-reveal><p><strong>An IT architect with 24 years in consulting, spanning delivery leadership, Oracle architecture and applied AI engineering.</strong> The journey includes work as a project manager, product owner, solution architect, release manager and transition leader.</p><p>Today, that delivery discipline comes together with hands-on AI engineering. The result is work that understands both the enterprise process and the system being built around it.</p><div class="role-cloud"><span>Solution Architect</span><span>Project Manager</span><span>Product Owner</span><span>Release Manager</span><span>Transition Manager</span><span>Service Delivery</span></div></div></div>
</section>
<section class="section" id="work">
<div class="section-kicker" data-reveal><span>02</span> Selected outcomes</div>
<div class="section-heading" data-reveal><div><p class="eyebrow">Applied AI on enterprise data</p><h2>Work that earns<br>its place in production.</h2></div><p>Agents, retrieval, predictive models and natural-language experiences built around real Oracle Fusion workflows.</p></div>
<div class="outcome-grid">
<article class="outcome-card" data-reveal><div class="card-top"><span>01</span><b>Agentic procurement</b></div><h3>From inventory signal to autonomous action</h3><p>Cooperating agents watch inventory, decide replenishment and raise the action on Fusion procurement data.</p><div class="tags"><span>LangGraph</span><span>Multi-agent</span><span>Oracle Fusion</span></div></article>
<article class="outcome-card" data-reveal><div class="card-top"><span>02</span><b>Financial knowledge</b></div><h3>Ask the documents. Keep the evidence.</h3><p>A retrieval system across spreadsheets and PDFs that gives finance teams grounded answers with the source in hand.</p><div class="tags"><span>RAG</span><span>LangChain</span><span>Embeddings</span></div></article>
<article class="outcome-card" data-reveal><div class="card-top"><span>03</span><b>Natural-language analytics</b></div><h3>A dashboard the moment you wonder</h3><p>A plain-English interface to payables data, turning a controller's question into an immediate visual answer.</p><div class="tags"><span>Analytics</span><span>OTBI</span><span>Natural language</span></div></article>
<article class="outcome-card" data-reveal><div class="card-top"><span>04</span><b>Predictive finance</b></div><h3>See risk before the numbers post</h3><p>Forecasting and anomaly models on Fusion data for customer churn, demand, sales and unusual financial transactions.</p><div class="tags"><span>PyTorch</span><span>scikit-learn</span><span>Forecasting</span></div></article>
<a class="outcome-card" href="https://kumr-oracle-ai.kumr.chatgpt.site/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Explore the Oracle AI Hub" data-reveal><div class="card-top"><span>05</span><b>Oracle-native agents</b></div><h3>Agentic workflows inside the Oracle stack</h3><p>Supervisor agents orchestrating workflow sub-agents using patterns certified across Oracle AI Agent Studio releases.</p><div class="tags"><span>AI Agent Studio</span><span>Supervisor</span><span>Workflow</span></div><span class="external-card-link">Explore the Oracle AI Hub <i>↗</i></span></a>
<article class="outcome-card" data-reveal><div class="card-top"><span>06</span><b>Receivables intelligence</b></div><h3>From dispute noise to trusted resolution</h3><p>Read-only classification, safe routing and clear trust boundaries for short-pays, pricing gaps and suspicious requests.</p><div class="tags"><span>Receivables</span><span>Human control</span><span>Agent safety</span></div></article>
</div>
<div class="lab-heading" data-reveal><h3>AI Lab Projects</h3><p>Explorations in grounded knowledge, agent coordination and persistent personal context.</p></div>
<div class="lab-grid">
<article class="lab-card" data-reveal><span class="lab-code">LAB / 01 · Knowledge</span><h3>Wiki LLM</h3><p>A citation-first conversational knowledge environment that turns a curated information corpus into grounded research and explainable answers.</p><div class="tags"><span>LLM</span><span>RAG</span><span>Citations</span></div></article>
<article class="lab-card" data-reveal><span class="lab-code">LAB / 02 · Orchestration</span><h3>Agentic OS</h3><p>A coordination layer for role-based agents, shared memory, tools, permissions and observable multi-step workflows.</p><div class="tags"><span>Agents</span><span>Memory</span><span>Tool use</span></div></article>
<article class="lab-card" data-reveal><span class="lab-code">LAB / 03 · Personal intelligence</span><h3>Second Brain Project</h3><p>A personal knowledge system designed to capture, connect and retrieve notes, documents and working context when they matter.</p><div class="tags"><span>Knowledge graph</span><span>Retrieval</span><span>Context</span></div></article>
</div>
</section>
<section class="section">
<div class="section-kicker" data-reveal><span>03</span> Two practices</div>
<div class="practice-grid">
<article class="practice" data-reveal><p class="eyebrow">Practice A</p><div class="practice-number">ERP</div><h2>Oracle Fusion,<br>implemented end to end.</h2><p>Discovery to hypercare across Financials, Project Portfolio Management, Procurement and Supply Chain. Implementations, upgrades, rollouts and support with a full-lifecycle view.</p><div class="module-list"><span>Financials</span><span>Project Portfolio Management</span><span>Supply Chain</span><span>Human Capital Management</span></div></article>
<article class="practice ai" data-reveal><p class="eyebrow">Practice B</p><div class="practice-number">AI</div><h2>Applied AI,<br>engineered to run.</h2><p>Autonomous agents, retrieval assistants, forecasting and anomaly detection with security, trust boundaries and human control designed in from the start.</p><div class="module-list"><span>Agentic workflows</span><span>Retrieval systems</span><span>Predictive models</span><span>Natural-language analytics</span></div></article>
</div>
<div class="delivery-spine" data-reveal><div class="spine-title"><p class="eyebrow">The delivery spine</p><h3>From question to outcome</h3></div><div class="steps"><div class="step"><span>01</span><h4>Discover</h4><p>Requirements, assessments and fit-gap mapping into a global design.</p></div><div class="step"><span>02</span><h4>Configure</h4><p>Fusion setup, accounting rules, approvals and access with a clear design spine.</p></div><div class="step"><span>03</span><h4>Connect</h4><p>Conversions and integrations with banks, B2B platforms and enterprise systems.</p></div><div class="step"><span>04</span><h4>Prove</h4><p>System, acceptance and regression testing with training built for adoption.</p></div><div class="step"><span>05</span><h4>Launch</h4><p>Conference-room pilots, cutover, go-live and transition without drama.</p></div><div class="step"><span>06</span><h4>Improve</h4><p>Hypercare, production support, enhancements and quarterly-release adoption.</p></div></div></div>
</section>
<section class="section footprint">
<div class="section-kicker" data-reveal><span>04</span> Enterprise range</div>
<div class="footprint-grid"><div data-reveal><p class="eyebrow">Platforms and process</p><h2>From On-Premise ERP<br>to Fusion Cloud ERP<br>to finally AI-Enabled ERP.</h2><p class="large-copy">Deep in Oracle Financials and Project Accounting, with range across Supply Chain and Human Capital Management.</p></div><div class="footprint-facts" data-reveal><div><span>Companies</span><p>IBM · Accenture · Capgemini · UST · Wipro · TCS</p></div><div><span>Industries</span><p>Banking · Energy · Telecom · Logistics · Consumer Goods · Manufacturing · Retail</p></div><div><span>Global delivery</span><p>United States · Czech Republic · India</p></div><div><span>Integrations</span><p>SAP Concur · Paycom · CyberSource · Banking systems · B2B platforms</p></div></div></div>
</section>
<section class="section" id="career">
<div class="section-kicker" data-reveal><span>05</span> Career</div>
<div class="section-heading" data-reveal><div><p class="eyebrow">Employer by employer</p><h2>Twenty-four years<br>of enterprise delivery.</h2></div><p>Roles and scope across the full Oracle journey, from implementation foundations to AI-enabled architecture.</p></div>
<div class="career-timeline">
<article data-reveal><time>2025 — Present</time><div><h3>IBM</h3><p class="career-role">Application Architect, Oracle ERP & AI</p><p>Oracle ERP Cloud architecture and applied-AI delivery across financial services and food processing, including presales and agentic delivery.</p></div></article>
<article data-reveal><time>2022 — 2025</time><div><h3>Accenture</h3><p class="career-role">Business Architect, Oracle ERP</p><p>Oracle ERP Cloud architecture plus generative-AI and machine-learning builds on Fusion data for consumer packaged goods.</p></div></article>
<article data-reveal><time>2012 — 2022</time><div><h3>Capgemini</h3><p class="career-role">Senior Project Manager / Oracle Cloud Architect</p><p>Fusion and E-Business Suite delivery across telecom, utility, logistics, financial services and oil and gas.</p></div></article>
<article data-reveal><time>2008 — 2012</time><div><h3>UST</h3><p class="career-role">Enterprise Solution Specialist</p><p>Oracle E-Business Suite Financials and Supply Chain, including global rollouts and production support.</p></div></article>
<article data-reveal><time>2002 — 2008</time><div><h3>Monster · Wipro · TCS · iGATE · InfoSoft</h3><p class="career-role">Consultant to Solution Analyst</p><p>Order to Cash and Procure to Pay implementations, support and data conversion across the United States, Prague and India.</p></div></article>
</div>
<p class="education" data-reveal><span>Education</span> Bachelor of Computer Science & Engineering · Amravati University · 1997 — 2001</p>
</section>
<section class="section">

<footer><a class="brand" href="#top">ENTERPRISE DEPTH <span>×</span> BUILDER'S INSTINCT</a><p>© <span id="year"></span> · Houston, TX</p><p>Oracle ERP × AI · Built to ship</p></footer>
<script>
document.getElementById('year').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();
const menuButton=document.getElementById('menuButton');
const navLinks=document.getElementById('navLinks');
menuButton.addEventListener('click',()=>{const open=navLinks.classList.toggle('is-open');menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open))});
navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>{navLinks.classList.remove('is-open');menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')}));
const updateProgress=()=>{const root=document.documentElement;const total=root.scrollHeight-root.clientHeight;root.style.setProperty('--progress',(total>0?root.scrollTop/total*100:0)+'%')};
const canvas=document.getElementById('motionCanvas');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true});
const reducedMotion=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
const identityVideo=document.getElementById('identityVideo');
const syncIdentityVideo=()=>{if(reducedMotion.matches){identityVideo.pause();identityVideo.currentTime=6}else identityVideo.play().catch(()=>{})};
identityVideo.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',syncIdentityVideo,{once:true});
reducedMotion.addEventListener?.('change',syncIdentityVideo);
let width=0,height=0,dpr=1,frame=0,animationId=0;
const pointer={x:-1000,y:-1000,targetX:-1000,targetY:-1000};
const ribbons=[
{base:.14,amp:34,speed:.006,phase:.2,width:1.15,alpha:.2},
{base:.31,amp:52,speed:.004,phase:1.7,width:.8,alpha:.13},
{base:.49,amp:42,speed:.005,phase:3.1,width:1.05,alpha:.16},
{base:.68,amp:58,speed:.0035,phase:4.4,width:.75,alpha:.12},
{base:.86,amp:38,speed:.0065,phase:5.6,width:1.1,alpha:.18}
];
const resizeCanvas=()=>{
dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);width=innerWidth;height=innerHeight;
canvas.width=Math.round(width*dpr);canvas.height=Math.round(height*dpr);
canvas.style.width=width+'px';canvas.style.height=height+'px';ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
};
const ribbonY=(r,x,time)=>{
const wave=Math.sin(x*.004+r.phase+time*r.speed)*r.amp+Math.sin(x*.011-r.phase*1.7+time*r.speed*.65)*r.amp*.22;
const dx=x-pointer.x;const influence=Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(dx)/240);const pull=(pointer.y-(r.base*height+wave))*influence*.08;
return r.base*height+wave+pull;
};
const drawMotion=(time=0)=>{
ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
pointer.x+=(pointer.targetX-pointer.x)*.045;pointer.y+=(pointer.targetY-pointer.y)*.045;
ribbons.forEach((r,index)=>{
const gradient=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,width,0);
gradient.addColorStop(0,`rgba(53,230,193,${r.alpha*.15})`);
gradient.addColorStop(.28,`rgba(53,230,193,${r.alpha})`);
gradient.addColorStop(.72,`rgba(199,169,107,${r.alpha*.8})`);
gradient.addColorStop(1,`rgba(53,230,193,${r.alpha*.08})`);
ctx.beginPath();
for(let x=-20;x<=width+20;x+=14){const y=ribbonY(r,x,time);if(x===-20)ctx.moveTo(x,y);else ctx.lineTo(x,y)}
ctx.strokeStyle=gradient;ctx.lineWidth=r.width;ctx.stroke();
const nodeX=((time*(.018+index*.003)+index*231)%(width+160))-80;
const nodeY=ribbonY(r,nodeX,time);const glow=ctx.createRadialGradient(nodeX,nodeY,0,nodeX,nodeY,18);
glow.addColorStop(0,'rgba(118,244,217,.7)');glow.addColorStop(.18,'rgba(53,230,193,.32)');glow.addColorStop(1,'rgba(53,230,193,0)');
ctx.fillStyle=glow;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(nodeX,nodeY,18,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
ctx.fillStyle='rgba(243,236,217,.72)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(nodeX,nodeY,1.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
});
ctx.restore();frame=time;
if(!reducedMotion.matches)animationId=requestAnimationFrame(drawMotion);
};
const startMotion=()=>{cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);if(reducedMotion.matches)drawMotion(frame);else animationId=requestAnimationFrame(drawMotion)};
addEventListener('resize',()=>{resizeCanvas();startMotion()},{passive:true});
addEventListener('pointermove',event=>{pointer.targetX=event.clientX;pointer.targetY=event.clientY},{passive:true});
addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{pointer.targetX=-1000;pointer.targetY=-1000},{passive:true});
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);else startMotion()});
reducedMotion.addEventListener?.('change',startMotion);resizeCanvas();startMotion();
const reveal=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(entry=>{if(entry.isIntersecting){entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');reveal.unobserve(entry.target)}}),{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]').forEach(el=>reveal.observe(el));
const finePointer=matchMedia('(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)').matches;
const interactiveCards=[...document.querySelectorAll('.outcome-card,.lab-card,.practice,.channel-card')];
interactiveCards.forEach(card=>card.classList.add('interactive-card'));
if(finePointer&&!reducedMotion.matches){
interactiveCards.forEach(card=>{
card.addEventListener('pointerenter',()=>{card.style.setProperty('--spot-opacity','1');card.style.setProperty('--lift','-4px')});
card.addEventListener('pointermove',event=>{
const box=card.getBoundingClientRect();const x=event.clientX-box.left;const y=event.clientY-box.top;
card.style.setProperty('--mx',x+'px');card.style.setProperty('--my',y+'px');
card.style.setProperty('--rx',((.5-y/box.height)*3.5)+'deg');card.style.setProperty('--ry',((x/box.width-.5)*4.5)+'deg');
});
card.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{card.style.setProperty('--spot-opacity','0');card.style.setProperty('--lift','0px');card.style.setProperty('--rx','0deg');card.style.setProperty('--ry','0deg')});
});
const portrait=document.querySelector('.portrait-shell');
portrait.addEventListener('pointermove',event=>{
const box=portrait.getBoundingClientRect();const x=event.clientX-box.left;const y=event.clientY-box.top;
portrait.style.setProperty('--portrait-x',((x/box.width-.5)*-10)+'px');portrait.style.setProperty('--portrait-y',((y/box.height-.5)*-8)+'px');
portrait.style.setProperty('--map-x',((x/box.width-.5)*12)+'px');portrait.style.setProperty('--map-y',((y/box.height-.5)*10)+'px');
});
portrait.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>['--portrait-x','--portrait-y','--map-x','--map-y'].forEach(name=>portrait.style.setProperty(name,'0px')));
}
const counters=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]')];
const counterObserver=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(entry=>{
if(!entry.isIntersecting)return;counterObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
const el=entry.target;if(reducedMotion.matches)return;const target=Number(el.dataset.count);const suffix=el.dataset.suffix||'';const started=performance.now();el.classList.add('is-counting');
const tick=now=>{const progress=Math.min(1,(now-started)/1500);const eased=1-Math.pow(1-progress,3);el.textContent=Math.round(target*eased)+suffix;if(progress<1)requestAnimationFrame(tick);else el.classList.remove('is-counting')};requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}),{threshold:.7});
counters.forEach(el=>counterObserver.observe(el));
updateProgress();addEventListener('scroll',updateProgress,{passive:true});
</script>
